import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long ans;
    static long n;
    static long cnt1;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sum = new long[7];
    static long cnt2;
    static long[] poww = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static void dfs1(int k1, long k2) {
        if (k1 == 7) return;
        val[k1].add((cnt1 - k2 + mod1) % mod1);
        sum[k1] = (sum[k1] + (cnt1 - k2 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
        cnt1++;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
            dfs1(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        final long half = 1000000L;
        return x * half + 999999 <= n && x * half * 10 > n;
    }

    static void dfs2(int k1, long k2) {
        if (k2 > n) return;
        if (check(k2)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                long offset = ((cnt2 + 1 - (k2 * poww[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], mod1 - offset);
                long add = (sum[i] + offset * val[i].size() - mod1 * (val[i].size() - pos)) % mod2;
                ans = (ans + add) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            cnt2++;
            ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - k2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
            for (int i = (k1 == 0 ? 1 : 0); i <= 9; ++i) {
                dfs2(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Long> list, long key) {
        int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, key);
        if (idx < 0) {
            return -idx - 1;
        } else {
            return idx;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        cnt2 = -1;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
